headline: Gas in Europe is getting more expensive again. Experts warn of winter
summary: European gas prices rose on Friday as tensions in the Middle East increased and supplies from Norway declined. Energy Aspects raised its gas price forecast for the rest of the winter by 3 euros per MWh to 96 euros.
why: European gas prices are set largely by supply from Norway and LNG imports, and they drive power costs and industrial energy budgets. Winter demand makes storage and supply shocks especially important.
why_moved: Rising Middle East tensions and lower Norwegian gas deliveries pushed prices up, and Energy Aspects raised its winter price forecast.
original_headline: Gaz w Europie znów drożeje. Eksperci ostrzegają przed zimą
